facts.business: KMS Medisurgi Limited manufactures and undertakes job work of coating various substrates with adhesive, and is engaged in ethical marketing and distribution of surgical disposables, medical devices, urology equipment, surgery equipment, orthopedic/physiotherapy equipment, blood banking equipment, and other surgical equipment in India.

auditor.name: M/S. H. H. DEDHIA AND ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to departure from AS-15 for post-employment benefits accounting based on LIC group gratuity report without actuarial valuation; unable to comment on movement and value of closing stock of Rs. 253.80 lacs as quantitative stock records commenced only from FY 2024-25 and are under reconciliation.

key_risks: Departure from AS-15 for employee benefits accounting without actuarial valuation
Incomplete quantitative stock records and reconciliation for inventory valuation
Dependence on government approvals as supplier
Concentration in healthcare equipment and supplies single segment
facts.related_party_note: Loan given to unrelated corporate entity for business purposes (Rs. 2.42 lacs in previous year); no other related party transactions disclosed in excerpts.
